LowPolyWorks viewer credits and third-party notices

The Warcraft III model viewer combines LowPolyWorks website integration,
MDLxL rendering components and third-party libraries. The war3-model license
covers that library; it is not the complete viewer's credits or a license for
the website, MDLxL code, models or Warcraft III assets.

Components used by the viewer

- LowPolyWorks / Unsanctioned Magic: website integration, catalogue model and
  texture loading, viewer controls, portraits and formation captures.
  Source: https://github.com/UnsctMagic/LowPolyWorks
- MDLxL / Unsanctioned Magic and contributors: Showcase animation playback,
  global-sequence and effect timing, graphics presets, lighting and geoset
  shader adapters, particle compatibility, billboard and portrait-camera
  handling, and editor camera controls. This website reuses these components;
  it is a catalogue viewer rather than the complete MDLxL editor.
  Bundled source provenance: MDLxL 0.18.7, commit
  349f262ba7a36cba4baed56ea1dc2ab4711982aa.
  Source: https://github.com/UnsctMagic/MDLxL/tree/349f262ba7a36cba4baed56ea1dc2ab4711982aa
- war3-model 4.0.1 / 4eb0da and contributors: MDX parsing and the underlying
  Warcraft III WebGL ModelRenderer, including model geometry, animation,
  particles and ribbons. MDLxL adapters extend its rendering behavior.
  MIT license: vendor/war3-model-LICENSE.txt
  Source: https://github.com/4eb0da/war3-model
- Three.js 0.183.2 / three.js authors and contributors: cameras, vectors,
  matrices, bounds and OrbitControls used by the viewer's camera controls.
  MIT license: vendor/three-LICENSE.txt
  Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- WhiteoutLib / Fernando Sahmkow (BlinkBoy): BLP1/BLP2 texture decoding through
  MDLxL's WebAssembly adapter. WhiteoutLib is a texture codec in this viewer.
  Pinned commit: 38d279c2a6d8d439377959c56fe4f1eb9ab12fa6.
  BSD-3-Clause license: whiteout/LICENSE
  Build provenance: whiteout/build.json
  Source: https://github.com/FernandoS27/WhiteoutLib

Technical references and upstream acknowledgements

- GhostWolf / flowtsohg, mdx-m3-viewer: event-object table and naming references
  in MDLxL's bundled event-preview-data.js. The website does not import the
  mdx-m3-viewer renderer as its runtime model renderer.
  Source: https://github.com/flowtsohg/mdx-m3-viewer
- Retera, Warsmash Mod Engine and Retera Model Studio: portrait-camera FOV
  reference in portrait-view.js and MDX geoset-color layout reference in
  geoset-color-codec.js, respectively.
  Sources: https://github.com/Retera/WarsmashModEngine
           https://github.com/Retera/ReterasModelStudio
- war3-model's own acknowledgements credit Magos (MDX specification and War3
  Model Editor), GhostWolf (MDX specification and BLP decoder code), Alexey /
  Алексей (MDLVis), and Dr Super Good (BLP specification).
  Upstream acknowledgements: https://github.com/4eb0da/war3-model/blob/v4.0.1/README.md#thanks

Game assets and fonts

Native Warcraft III textures and interface assets: Blizzard Entertainment.
Textures were extracted from the user's local Warcraft III classic archives.
Fonts: Cinzel and IM Fell English, served by Google Fonts, licensed under the
SIL Open Font License.
